statements.status_notes: GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 requires react-router 8.3.0, which is a major version upgrade from 7.x. The vulnerability affects unstable RSC APIs only. Evaluating compatibility and migration path for the major version jump. Current version 7.18.0 addresses other high and medium severity CVEs in the 7.x line.

GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 requires react-router 8.3.0, which is a major version upgrade from 7.x. The vulnerability affects unstable RSC APIs only. Evaluating compatibility and migration path for the major version jump. Current version 7.18.0 addresses other high and medium severity CVEs in the 7.x line.

GO-2026-5932 is reported against golang.org/x/crypto@0.54.0 with vulnerable range '>=0' and no fix available. The advisory is UNSPECIFIED severity with no details on affected functions or remediation path. Alloy includes golang.org/x/crypto as a transitive dependency; reachability of any vulnerable code paths in the shipped binary is under investigation. Tracking upstream Go security advisories for concrete fix guidance.

GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree (and subpackages), which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release. Scout matches golang.org/x/crypto at the module level because the advisory records the module with no fixed version. Analysis of this image's shipped Go binaries found no import or link of golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp; the vulnerable OpenPGP code is therefore not present in the shipped artifacts (vulnerable_code_not_present).

grafana/alloy v1.16.1 imports github.com/docker/docker v28.5.2+incompatible via the legacy pre-rebrand path. The upstream fix lives in github.com/moby/moby/v2 (post-rebrand module split); no higher version exists on the legacy docker/docker import path. A bump requires alloy upstream to migrate its import paths to moby/v2. Reachability of the docker cp archive-extraction code path in alloy's runtime (container metadata and log discovery only) is pending assessment.
